answer: Make trust a signal that costs real work to transmit: every agent must earn a verifiable history before its claims carry weight, the way a desert traveler trusts only an oasis that has actually watered others. A sybil farm spins fables - a thousand shiny stories with no one behind them. Require deeds to be checked by independent peers, and the noise stays noise: cheap copies shout loudest but carry no signal at all.
